title: Recovery equations persist under an arbitrary later base change
statement: Let X_0,X_1,X_2,Z be schemes [def-pc-scheme], with maps h:X_1→X_0, q:X_2→X_1, p:Z→X_2, b:Z→X_1, a:Z→X_0 and d:X_2→X_0. Assume p q=b, q h=d, b h=a and p d=a, where juxtaposition means composition from left to right. Let F,G be modules on X_0, and φ:a^*F→a^*G a morphism of tensor pullbacks [def-pc-module-pullback]. Let e_0:a^*≅h^* b^*, e:a^*≅d^* p^*, and z:d^*≅h^* q^* be supplied natural isomorphisms, each equal to the canonical tensor composition comparison for its displayed map equation [def-pc-tensor-pullback-composition-iso]. Let U_0 be an open cover of X_1, and r_0 a family of maps between the ordinary restrictions of h^*F and h^*G. Assume its pullback along b, conjugated by the restriction comparison [def-pc-open-cover-tensor-pullback-comparison], is the restriction of e_0^{-1} φ e_0 on every member of b^*U_0. Put U=q^*U_0, V=p^*U, A=d^*, and A_0=h^*. Define r on U by restricting z.hom on F, applying the inverse restriction comparison for q, pulling back r_0 along the cover map to U_0, applying the forward restriction comparison, and restricting z.inv on G. Then for every member of V, the pullback of r along p, conjugated by its restriction comparison, is the restriction of e.inv(F) φ e.hom(G). The cover is arbitrary, and no finite presentation, affine cover, directed stage, or descent-morphism assertion is assumed or concluded.

source.place: Tag 01ZR, first proof, base change of local lifts; Sheaves of Modules Tags 0095 and 0096

proof.text: Substitute the functor equalities and the three heterogeneous canonicality equations. Apply localMapRecovery_composition to the modules h^*F and h^*G and the map e0.inv;phi;e0.hom. It gives recovery for the family pulled back along q with identity outer maps.

Naturality of the restriction comparison shows that recovery is preserved by precomposition and postcomposition with arbitrary global maps. Apply this to z.hom(F) and z.inv(G). The resulting component family is the five-factor localMapPullbackFamily in the conclusion, by ordinary pullback functoriality.

Apply tensorPullbackCompositionIso_associativity at F and G. Precompose its equation at F with e.hom and cancel inverse pairs to obtain p^*(z.hom(F));c.inv;e0.inv=e.inv. At G its equation and cancellation give e0.hom;c.hom;p^*(z.inv(G))=e.hom. Substitute these two identities into the global recovered map and reassociate to obtain e.inv;phi;e.hom, as required.

proof_origin.place: Canonical comparison and naturality calculation, using Tags 0095, 0096 and 0097 and the local-lift argument of Tag 01ZR.
